example_sentence: The army massacred more than 150 unarmed civilians.

etymology: in(不)+evitable(可避免的)→不可避免的
example_sentence: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.

definition_zh: v. 猜想；怀疑；adj. 可疑的；n. 嫌疑犯
etymology: sus(下， 后)+(s)pect(看)→在下面偷偷地看→怀疑

example_sentence: Chenier and the band are performing at the Silver Palace tomorrow.

definition_zh: adj. 中世纪的,中古(时代)的；老式的,原始的

example_sentence: The elephants are still menaced by poachers.
